method: The supplied fixed V matrix exactly matches a recovered published 182-addition SLP, independently verified. Perminov LEO first produced a 165-gate donor. Our pool combined 40 donor circuits into 426 exact forms and 2483 productions in 1.1815 seconds. Starting from 165, plateau helper-exchange search reached 161 additions at 3.7732 seconds after pool assembly; the full 60-second run retained 161. Fixed input/output sign orientation followed by independent literal replay verified all 5760 source coefficients, with no standalone negations or scalar multiplications. The 161 count is a verified upper bound for this fixed V linear map, with no basis change and no optimality claim.
scope: Only the supplied V matrix with original input and output coordinates and signs.
limitations: Only V was supplied; this is not a full matrix multiplication addition count.
No runtime improvement inferred from an arithmetic count.
